global_holds: An incoming_scope is not a license to export the entire incoming letter: emit only listed retained paragraphs/spans.
Headers, salutations, footnotes, annotations, bibliography, and joint or third-party voices require separate source-layer checks; absent or unverifiable evidence remains held.
Response spans are kept distinct from incoming spans; no incoming date is substituted for the Darwin response date.

Two accepted evidence references (DCP-LETT-758 for response 775 and DCP-LETT-1934 for response 1944) supplied no body paragraph/character span in the current period inventory; they remain explicit source-span holds rather than broad keyword matches.
